title: 2025 New England Woodfiring Conference - 4 Day Workshop at Orchard Street Pottery
source_quote: As part of the 2025 New England Woodfiring Conference, Orchard Street Pottery will be hosting a 4 day workshop where participants will be able to fire their own work as they join in firing the kiln.
evidence_sentence: The workshop page states participants will fire their own work while joining in firing the kiln.
evidence_quote: participants will be able to fire their own work as they join in firing the kiln
summary: A 4-day workshop at Orchard Street Pottery as part of the 2025 New England Woodfiring Conference where participants fire their own work in the wood-fired kiln. Specific dates are not stated on the page.
